long_biography.plain_text:
At Banco Daycoval, Morris Dayan has worked on the bank’s relationship with outside investors as well as its executive management. As investor relations director in 2009, he explained a financing agreement involving international investors and the bank’s controlling shareholder. The arrangement linked bank deposits to rights to buy shares later. It was intended to widen the bank’s funding sources and allow new investors into its ownership.

Away from banking, Dayan has spent more than twenty years sailing and has raced with the crew of Atrevida. His participation in Ilhabela’s international sailing week reached a tenth appearance in 2024. He describes time at sea as a way to disconnect from work and regards finishing a race as an achievement in itself.
long_biography.html:
At Banco Daycoval, Morris Dayan has worked on the bank’s relationship with outside investors as well as its executive management. As investor relations director in 2009, he explained a financing agreement involving international investors and the bank’s controlling shareholder. The arrangement linked bank deposits to rights to buy shares later. It was intended to widen the bank’s funding sources and allow new investors into its ownership.

Away from banking, Dayan has spent more than twenty years sailing and has raced with the crew of Atrevida. His participation in Ilhabela’s international sailing week reached a tenth appearance in 2024. He describes time at sea as a way to disconnect from work and regards finishing a race as an achievement in itself.
